text:
Priya: Heads-up: client invoice flag from Acme shows two GPU jobs charged to marketplace-internal instead of being passed-through. Potentially $8.6k of billable spend that should go to Acme invoice #A-3321. Can SRE confirm source?
Omar: Looking now. Quick read of billing export shows a marketplace SKU + partner_account label missing. Some jobs launched via the marketplace flow used the platform SA instead of the partner SA.
Priya: Oof. If Acme already paid we risk under-invoicing them. We need clear evidence before we patch invoices.
Omar: Minimal dig here. Sample BQ query to surface the lines: 
```
SELECT invoice_id, usage_start_time, sku.description, cost, labels.partner_account, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail
FROM `billing_prod.gcp_exports.line_items_*`
WHERE sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
AND invoice_id = 'INV-2026-11-A3321'
AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30'
```
Lina: Pinged Acme account team to freeze invoice adjustments until we confirm. They asked for ETA by EOD PST.
billing-bot: AutomatedNotice: Marketplace consumption anomaly detected for partner "acme-corp". Cluster: marketplace-prod-01. Case: MKT-4623. Link: https://billing.internal/cases/MKT-4623
Gabe: From accounting POV we need a clear mapping of job -> partner SA or a signed pass-through statement. If it's our mistake we should issue a corrected invoice + credit note.
Omar: Found three runs: mkp-run-911, mkp-run-914, mkp-run-920. All created from lambda that didn't attach partner label due to a regression in the marketplace proxy (PR #4123 rolled back tags). Estimated charge: $8,620. I can export the exact line items and the proxy logs.
Priya: Can you also check whether committed-use discounts or reservation credits were applied to these runs? That changes customer charge logic.
Omar: Good call. Early look: two runs consumed pre-purchased marketplace reservations. That is messy because reservations were purchased under partner pool. If credits applied to internal account, we need to separate net charge amounts.
Lina: I'll ask Acme if they received a PDF invoice with these lines. If yes we need to escalate to legal for contract implications.
Gabe: For now prepare two artifacts: (1) per-line billing export CSV mapping line_item_id -> correct partner tag, (2) daemon logs showing missing label with PR hash. We'll attach both to the accounting adjustment.
Priya: Decision path: if we can deterministically reassign lines via backfill we will issue corrected invoice and a credit note. If we can't backfill reservations cleanly we will process an internal journal to move $8.62k to cost_of_sales and issue credit to Acme. Approvals needed: @Gabe (accounting) and @Lina (sales ops).
Omar: I'll drop the CSV into /shared/finance/acme_mkt_corrections/ and post link here when ready. Also opening a tracking issue in infra: infra#927 (label: billing-tag-rollback).
billing-bot: CaseUpdated: MKT-4623 -> state: investigating by infra.
Priya: ETA request: Omar, can you get the CSV + log snippets by 3pm PST? Lina/Gabe, can you confirm approval window (48 hours) to re-issue invoice if evidence is clean?
Omar: Yes 3pm PST doable.
Lina: 48 hours is fine from sales ops. Notify Acme's billing contact that reissued invoice will be sent subject to evidence.
Gabe: Accounting gives provisional OK for correction upon receipt of CSV + logs. We'll need sign-off on final numbers before issuing credit note.
Priya: Thanks. Action items: Omar -> export CSV of offending line items + confirm reservation credit mapping; Lina -> hold client outreach + confirm contract exposure; Gabe -> prep journal template for correction; Priya -> coordinate with legal if needed.
Omar: Uploading CSV now. Link: https://files.internal/finance/acme_mkt_corrections/mkp_2026_11_lines.csv
Priya: Got it. I'll draft the corrected invoice flow and loop in Legal if Lina flags contract risk.
Lina: Will update Acme and keep thread posted.
Gabe: Once final numbers are set, I'll route the credit note for CFO sign-off.
Priya: Closing loop here for now. If infra needs a stricter guardrail, I'd support a mandatory partner SA check at proxy checkout.
Omar: I'll add a proxy preflight check in PR #4187.
Priya: Appreciate quick response team.
